newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta shares end mixed at close, focus on Astra.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta shares end mixed at close, focus on Astra.

text.p: Jakarta share prices closed mixed on Monday, with the focus still on automotive giant PT Astra International, brokers said.
They said, however, the index ended up slightly on rises in some big capitalised stocks amid lukewarm trading.
The Jakarta composite index inched up 0.11 percent, or 0.64 points, to close at 573.94 points. Losers led gainers by 51 to 49, with 62 issues unchanged.
Brokers said Astra International remained the focus, but the share price was little changed, edging up only one point to close at 3,800 rupiah on a volume of 3.4 million shares.
Some 6.2 million shares were crossed and one million shares changed hands on the block board.
One foreign broker said enthusiasm for on Astra continued and investors were waiting for the disclosure of possible changes in its shareholder structure.
The capital market watchdog Bapepam announced share purchases by tobacco tycoon Putera Sampoerna, who said he had accumulated a 9.81 percent stake in the company.
One analyst said Astra foreign shares were trading at about 12 times 1997 prospective earnings, which was relatively high in view of its growth and earnings prospects.
He said, however, the outlok may be different if well- connected tycoons had taken up stakes in the widely diversified conglomerate, with interests ranging from cars to banking.
Another foreign brokerage analyst said cement counters were well supported by offshore players, with Semen Cibinong and Semen Gresik gaining 6.4 and 4.55 percent, respectively.
He said investors seemed to return to infrastructure plays as fears over possible overcapacity diminished on delays in some projects.
Property firm Bhuwanatala IP topped the active list on a volume of 13.6 million shares.
It fell 75 rupiah to close at 1,250 rupiah following the announcement of a rights-cum-warrant issue.
The firm proposed a 10-for-four rights issue, with a warrant attached, at 500 rupiah a share. The issue is subject to shareholder approval on November 11, 1996.
Other active counters included Lippo Securities, Kedawung Setia and Duta Pertiwi. Among the losers were Indah Kiat, Indosat and market heavyweight Telkom which put pressure on the index.
